files.name: hero-v4-dodge
files.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production transparent RPG dodge animation atlas, PORTRAIT 1024x1536 pixels, exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, equal 256x384 cells, 16 isolated full-body sprites. Image 1 is the ONLY adult anatomy/material/clothes mother reference; image 2 is the ONLY four-direction identity/costume reference. Preserve this exact mature slender human man: small natural curly-haired head, adult face, muted teal-grey embroidered short cape, fitted brown fine-grain leather armor, ivory woven rolled-sleeve shirt, one brushed-steel shoulder, small practical belt pouches, long slim brown trouser legs, fitted calf boots. Match the references' realistic skin/hair/leather/linen/steel detail, subtle daylight color and roughness. No cartoon/chibi/toy proportions, no smooth plastic or golden outlines. Do not enlarge the head or thicken torso/legs. Straightened anatomy is 7.7-8 heads tall with a clear high waist and long thighs/shins, same bone lengths, head size and camera scale in ALL 16 drawings.
Arrange directions by ROWS exactly: row1 front facing viewer (down); row2 facing right, right profile; row3 facing away (up/back); row4 facing left, left profile. Neutral level camera with only slight elevation, like input image 2, no high bird view. Every column is a successive phase of one LOW-AMPLITUDE SIDESTEP DODGE CYCLE, not four separate actions. Column1 ready/preparation: mostly erect, knees softly flexed, small weight transfer, hands open for balance. Column2 short lateral slip: leading foot moves a modest distance sideways, hips remain high, gentle whole-body lean under 10 degrees, support knee slightly bends, no deep squat. Column3 trailing foot follows under hips to catch balance, both long legs readable, no knee to chest or heel to butt. Column4 recovery: return close to column1's erect ready stance, natural balanced empty hands. The silhouette stays tall throughout; peak dodge head-to-ground height no less than about94% of ready. This is a compact evasive sidestep, NOT a roll, somersault, seated squat, crouch-ball, exaggerated split or airborne tuck.
HANDS MUST BE EMPTY IN ALL FRAMES. No exposed main-hand sword, bow, staff, shield or magical weapon. A fixed small sheathed blade/scabbard attached to belt is allowed, but no drawn blade and no moving props. Keep clothes and equipment identity constant across directions. At this scale each upright figure is roughly335-350 pixels tall within its384px-high cell; head small around42px, not50-60px. Preserve real anatomy by redrawing, never stretching pixels. Preserve entire hair, arms, hands, boots and cape inside its own cell with at least10px transparent gutter; no sprite crosses a cell edge, no neighboring fragments. Similar bottom ground contact near y365 of each row, body centered within each cell, no exaggerated horizontal sheet-layout drift. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA around all silhouettes, clean edges and transparent openings. No opaque/semicopaque grey backdrop, floor, ground shadow, vignette, halo, fog, glow, checkerboard, labels, grid lines, letters, numbers or UI. The backdrop of the references is NOT part of this output. Output exactly one portrait1024x1536 atlas, same realistic adult identity and material quality.
